query:
SELECT pgz.*, p.name as plant_name, p.latin_name, gz.name as zone_name 
FROM plant_geographic_zones pgz 
JOIN plants p ON pgz.plant_id = p.id 
JOIN geographic_zones gz ON pgz.zone_id = gz.id 
LIMIT 10
